study.question: Does preserving the existing ordinal recency band in the background feedback rate improve the quality retained by target-field compression, and does including the slot itself explain the effect? Observed limitation: g2-r0004-count_shrink has validation macro AUC 0.8272805336635536 versus 0.8267496174922002 for g2-r0004-local_bridge, but purchase AUC falls from 0.8984067443589842 to 0.8970811065217827. Its count-over-fixed advantage is only 0.0001923633971738 macro AUC; neither this nor the reverse-count result removes the smoothing-dose explanation. The purchase regression is concentrated in existing history_17_64 (0.8760663283031356 to 0.8741573374007725; 1001754 samples, 1587 positives) and history_gt64 (0.9244313984014453 to 0.9231012239507748; 1401885 samples, 1510 positives); history_1_16 changes 0.8533786838547585 to 0.8536447434627795 (461684 samples, 926 positives). These are exploratory observations, not proof of a recency mechanism. Code inspection shows that the current global prior pools old and recent slots and includes the slot being smoothed.
study.hypothesis: A background constructed from the same existing ordinal band may preserve local feedback context that is diluted by a whole-prefix background, reducing the observed long-history purchase trade-off without adding learned capacity. The full candidate additionally excludes the current disjoint slot from that background, testing whether useful cross-slot feedback is obscured by self-inclusion. These are separable, provisional hypotheses. Ordinal position is not elapsed time; there are no timestamps. Background event support and smoothing dose are competing explanations. For slot s let n_s be all valid event count, k_st be masked feedback positives, f_st=k_st/max(n_s,1). Choose P(s) as all eight slots or the four slots in s's band. Compute background count N_P and successes K_Pt from the same valid prefix; optionally subtract n_s and k_st. If background count is zero use f_st, else p_st=K_Pt/N_P. Gate g_st=n_s/(n_s+4)*f_st+4/(n_s+4)*p_st. Only the existing product W(mean_s item fields)*g_st changes. Raw f_st, content slots, counts and target/context features stay explicit. Empty content slots remain zero.

study.proposed_difference: Implement one coherent background-selection mechanism as a complete 2x2 factorial: global_inclusive (control/parent bridge), band_inclusive (scope-only control), global_exclusive (exclusion-only control), band_exclusive (candidate.py, full candidate). Each variant is a standalone module; class ASTs and learned module construction are identical across arms. Raw slot success counts are retained before normalization and used for exclusion; never reconstruct counts from rounded rates. All arms compute the same global and per-band sufficient statistics. Empty peer sets fall back to the slot's own rate without borrowing from the opposite band or outside the 100 visible inputs. This tests what the background should summarize, not a claim that a Bayesian prior is independent or that a new compression family has been invented. Primary searches for smoothing/recency returned no directly audited shrinkage method; originality remains unverified. Local verification completed: all four modules compile; class ASTs are identical; inherited module construction/reset order is preserved; study required fields/types, evidence IDs, configs and complete factorial checked against the resolved contract. An independent exact-rational scalar specification passed 500 generated count/feedback cases, checking bounds, occupied-slot single-band equality, no-peer fallback and inclusive-dose decomposition. These do not substitute for PyTorch/BF16 execution.
predictions: Scope prediction: band_inclusive versus global_inclusive and band_exclusive versus global_exclusive improve macro AUC and tend to recover purchase AUC on existing history_17_64 and history_gt64 slices. The full band_exclusive candidate is predicted to beat the global_inclusive parent bridge, but may fail if its peer background is too sparse or semantically mismatched.

Exclusion prediction: band_exclusive versus band_inclusive and global_exclusive versus global_inclusive improve the useful separation of local and complementary feedback. If effects disagree across scopes, report the interaction rather than an unconditional exclusion benefit.

At identical weights and evaluation mode, global and band gates with the same exclusion flag are identical on OCCUPIED slots for rows whose valid history lies entirely within one ordinal band, including all pre-padded histories of length <=16. Empty slots in the other band may have different gates but always have zero projected content, so the resulting products and full shared-state predictions must agree. Empty-history content/products are zero. These are implementation negative controls, not predictions that independently trained models will have equal slice metrics.

The class graph adds zero trainable parameters and no learned event-level projection. Additional sums, broadcasts and slot arithmetic should keep cost near the parent 286.96-second full unit and 10.45 ms p50 model batch latency, but only new host timing can establish actual cost or a quality-cost frontier.
falsifiers: If neither band-scoped arm beats its corresponding global arm in validation macro AUC, the proposed background-scope implementation is unsupported. Purchase recovery alone cannot override the equal-weight four-task selection rule. A single null implementation does not refute all recency-aware compression.

If exclusion-only and full contrasts show no gain, or effects are fully explainable by changed offslot mixing dose or background support, do not claim self-inclusion is the mechanism. A later mass-matched control would be needed to distinguish these explanations; do not tune strength after this round without a new prospective study.

Any nonfinite output/gradient, out-of-range probability, changed output sample/task identity, dependence on masked payloads/current target action, failed single-band occupied-gate/product equality, or unexpected added trainable parameters invalidates the implementation before scientific scoring.

If effects disappear or reverse under authorized paired seeds, downgrade evidence to single-seed local observation. Exact duplicate fixed-seed runs verify execution determinism, not independent repeated mechanism support.
A material measured cost increase without better validation quality defeats an efficiency claim; equal shapes and parameter counts alone do not prove matched compute.
alternative_explanations: Same-band backgrounds have fewer samples and potentially higher variance. Restricting background changes its positive-event composition; this contrast does not identify temporal drift separately from support size.

Excluding a slot changes both the background and the effective amount of cross-slot smoothing. Under an inclusive global prior the effective complementary-slot weight is 4*(N-n)/(N*(n+4)); under exclusion it is 4/(n+4) when peers exist. A gain cannot by itself establish calibrated reliability or independence.

Historical events from one user and their feedback are correlated; leave-slot-out does not provide an independent statistical prior. Target match slots reflect inherited auxiliary category/brand label semantics.

Single fixed-seed training and reused validation selection remain preliminary; changed feature scales alter optimization. Full paired repetitions and user-cluster uncertainty require later host support. No significance or novelty claim follows from one round.

Trajectory review: target-field routing beats position routing at both early and late timings in round0, but this does not prove arbitrary finer routing works. Round1 counts-only (0.7669714771846765) and no-history (0.7313912513265209) fail relative to content summaries; therefore preserve content rather than preselect counts as a winning mechanism.

Round2 joint feedback-content moments (0.8263530772600421) fail to beat factorized moments (0.826699448769301); composition-only and widened-parent controls are weaker. This favors retaining simple factorized content gates but does not refute every within-slot association.

Round3 pooled-content replacement (0.8225525586315879) is weaker; global rates (0.8262190704838492) improve click but hurt purchase versus pooled-local (0.8267496174922002). Pooled reassociation reduces measured memory/latency with a small numerical quality difference; it is inherited algebraic engineering, not a new mechanism here.

Round4 count, fixed and reverse mixtures all exceed the raw-local macro result, leaving generic blending as a live explanation. Local bridge repeats exactly at the fixed seed, not an independent initialization. All visible trials succeeded; no execution failure is fabricated, and previous_runtime_error is null.
